source.label: Williams Triple Action factory instruction cards

strategy.overview: Triple Action and add-a-ball Star Action build Bonus in the upper lanes, then raise it from single to double and triple through the center spinner or lit top lane. Max the base Bonus before working A-B-C-D. On Star Action, repeated target-bank completions can add balls; on Triple Action, the bank is mainly a fixed award.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Triple Action or Star Action, keep shooting up top to build Bonus, then use the center spinner or lit top lane to reach Triple Bonus. Max the base Bonus before shooting A-B-C-D. On Star Action, completing that bank twice can add a ball; on Triple Action, it scores a fixed award.
strategy.summary: Build the base value first and use a clean spinner hit to reduce the number of dangerous top returns needed for Triple Bonus. Delay the center drop targets until the multiplier is ready, especially on replay-model Triple Action.

quickInfo.name: Build Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Top rollover buttons, the lit top lane, and drop targets advance the base Bonus.

quickInfo.name: Raise Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: The center spinner or lit top lane advances single to double to triple Bonus.

quickInfo.name: A-B-C-D on Triple Action
quickInfo.summary: Completing the bank scores the installed fixed award; it does not add a ball.

quickInfo.name: A-B-C-D on Star Action
quickInfo.summary: Two completions on one ball can award an additional ball when enabled.

steps.text: Plunge across as many top Bonus rollovers as possible, then finish in the currently lit top lane.
Keep sending the ball up top until the base Bonus reaches its maximum.
Hit the center spinner when its posts are horizontal enough for a strong spin, or use the lit top lane, until Triple Bonus is active.
On Star Action, complete A-B-C-D twice for an additional ball when enabled; make the outside targets before the center pair.
On Triple Action, take the A-B-C-D bank only after Bonus is prepared or when the fixed completion award is worth its rebound risk.

buildsToward.title: Maximum base Bonus at Triple Bonus

steps.text: Build the base Bonus in the upper playfield.
Advance the multiplier through the spinner or lit lane.
Use the prepared value before committing to the center target bank.

machineSetup: Identify Triple Action versus add-a-ball Star Action, confirm three- or five-ball play, and verify whether target-bank completions award points, replay, Extra Ball, or a conversion.
Test all top rollover buttons and lit-lane movement, center spinner and advance unit, A-B-C-D targets and reset, Bonus unit, multiplier lamps, and end-of-ball collect.
